Messages.Author: BaaliJusticar
Messages.Body:
Hi all,

I've play tested an idea a couple of times and am wondering what/where to submit a new storyline/variant to see if it is viable to be published via VEKN.
The idea is that there is a warehouse full of equipment that can be raided by the players in various ways. The edge is not obtained by bleeding, but by the player with the most equipment.
There are limits on what vampires and cards you can play, but no new cards are necessary.

Do I need to contact Ben Peal to discuss this?
Please advise.

Kind regards.
